notes:
Inbound from website 'doc search' quickstart. Customer: PageSpring (SMB, content SaaS). Current stack: FE + EKS, uses FAISS-based vector store hosted on EKS. Primary problem: inconsistent retrieval relevance for enterprise docs and high ops burden to maintain embeddings pipeline. Interested in Redwood hosted API for embeddings + reranking to reduce infra and costs. Key ask: how to integrate Redwood embeddings with existing FAISS / vector DB; can we push embeddings into their DB or use Redwood-managed vectors? Questions about batch vs online embedding costs, latency for 200–500 qps spikes, and fallback when model unavailable.
Short quotes from product lead: "We need relevance that doesn't degrade after content updates — we currently reindex nightly, but freshness still lags."
Security: SOC2 required for buying, SSO desired but not blocker for PoC. Data residency not required (NA only). Cost sensitivity: SMB budget, looking to keep monthly under $2k during POC.
POC success criteria: increase MRR conversion from search (measured via CTR on results) and reduce infra ops time by 50%.
Recommended approach from AE/SE: use Hosted API embeddings with periodic batch embedding jobs (for initial migrate) + on-demand single-shot embeddings for recency updates; use Redwood reranking endpoint to post-rank candidate hits from FAISS — lowers vector DB size and improves relevance. Provide sample architecture doc and costs.
Next steps: Ava to send pricing + quickstart. Marco to run a 60m technical deep-dive and provide sample code for FAISS ingest + reranking example. Customer to provide representative docs set for baseline eval.
